entities.summary: Saft el-Hinna, also written as Saft el-Hinneh, Saft el-Henna, Saft el-Henneh, is a village and an archaeological site in Egypt. It is located in the modern Al Sharqia Governorate, in the Nile Delta, about 7 km southeast of Zagazig. Saft el-Hinna is a archaeological site from Africa. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
